report.summary: Total reviews across the window reached 4054 with an overall positive share of 94.1%. Off-topic negative reviews accounted for 0.42% of scored negative reviews in the window. Reviewers with under 2 hours of playtime made up 1.97% of reviews in the window compared to 0.87% in the baseline. There were 0 sale days and 0 discount days during the review window. At horizon 7, the estimated patch effect on positive share was -0.14 percentage points, and at horizon 14 it was -0.12 percentage points. A review bomb and noise are ruled out. The patch, a price change or sale, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive.
